name: ซันแอนด์มูน GX Starter Deck ดับเบิ้ลเบิร์ส

description.text: GX Starter Deck: Double Burst, a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon-GX, damage counters, a GX marker and a rule book. Its pool includes TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX such as Celebi & Venusaur-GX and Gengar & Mimikyu-GX. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
